international.title: Two Médecins Sans Frontières staff killed in Israeli strike in Gaza, charity says
international.summary: MSF and head of WHO denounce attack on Gaza City clinic as Israel claims security guards were members of Hamas Israeli forces have bombed a clinic run by Médecins Sans Frontières in Gaza City, killing two of its staff members, the organisation has said. MSF said Israel directly struck the clinic, despite the fact that its location was known to the Israeli military and that it was well marked with MSF logos. The organisation denounced the attack and said that with the deaths of the two security guards on Saturday, Israel had killed 17 of its staff members during the war in Gaza. Continue reading...
